title: Lucy's Hideaway Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Tucked away behind the main cottage, ‘Lucy’s Hideaway’ invites visitors with a cozy retreat, small in size yet big on comfort and big on privacy.
description_expanded: Charming Seaside LocationTucked behind the main home, Lucy’s Hideaway offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of Seaside, Florida, just seven houses from the beach and one block from the Seaside town square. This lemon-hued carriage house is ideal for a romantic escape or small family getaway, comfortably accommodating up to four guests while keeping everything you love about Seaside just steps away.Private Outdoor SpacesSurrounded by mature landscaping, a wooden walkway leads to a private deck with outdoor seating—perfect for soaking up the coastal breeze in a quiet, tucked-away setting. Additional balconies and outdoor nooks provide inviting spaces to enjoy morning coffee, afternoon relaxation, or evening nightcaps beneath the trees.Comfortable Sleeping ArrangementsThe ground floor features a spacious king bedroom with room for a dresser and a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, along with an ensuite full bathroom for added privacy and convenience. A queen sleeper sofa in the upstairs living area allows for two additional guests, making this home well-suited for couples or small groups.Open Living & Dining AreaUpstairs, the main living space welcomes guests with high ceilings, natural light, and a relaxed coastal feel. Custom built-in bar-top kitchen seating provides a casual dining option, while a cozy dining nook opens to a private balcony—an ideal spot to enjoy Seaside’s charm from above.Fully Equipped KitchenThe galley kitchen is fresh and functional, featuring granite countertops, a full suite of appliances, and ample cabinetry. Whether you’re preparing a full meal or grabbing a quick beach snack, the kitchen is thoughtfully designed for convenience and ease.Thoughtful Details ThroughoutBeach-inspired colors carry through the home, from the cheerful exterior to the soft pastels, crisp white accents, and subtle pops of color inside. With in-unit stacked washer and dryer, custom built-ins, and a welcoming layout, Lucy’s Hideaway offers the comforts of home wrapped in the charm of a true Seaside vacation home.* 5 night minimum for Summer; Spring Break is 7 nights Sat to Sat only; 4 night minimum for Winter, Spring, & Fall. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES492 square feet322 feet or a one-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30AOutdoor charcoal grillPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass per one-bedroom home. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002141
